models.notes: Gate 1 PASSED: WAR 0.627 vs 0.728; coverage 0.800. IN-PROGRESS FIX (2026-06-13, owner: 'Lindor's WAR falls off a cliff / future years too low'): the heads + PT model train on COMPLETED seasons, but the LIVE base-1 season is partial (~41% elapsed at a June rebuild). Feeding the raw partial season made a durable regular briefly hurt this year (Lindor: 105 PA / 0.5 WAR vs his ~700 PA / ~6 WAR norm) read as a bad FULL season -> projected as a part-timer with an out-year cliff. Fix: reliability-blend the in-progress season's PT (fa_projection.project_player) AND the ML lag features war/exposure (proj_ml.build_features) toward the player's established (prior completed) level, weighted by the unobserved fraction (1-frac); healthy regulars whose current pace matches their track record are ~unchanged (population median y1 delta 0.000), only limited/injured veterans lift (mean +0.07). LIVE-ONLY: the gates project from completed seasons (in_progress=None), so Gate-1 (war 0.627, coverage 0.800) and Gate-2 are BYTE-UNCHANGED - re-confirmed PASS. Lindor 6.7 -> 12.2 5y WAR, cliff removed. Trade-off (disclosed): a player limited by losing the job, not injury, is also lifted - the lesser error for a star-heavy surface.

models.baseline: marcel_decay_v2 (retained as stack feature + fallback + h6+ shape)
models.metric: h1-5 MAE/bias/star-slice/tail-ratio + band coverage/pinball
models.notes: SHIPPED 2026-06-11 under best-model-wins: dev bases + gate targets + touched-once 2022-2024 holdout all beat the champion (gate-targets h1 MAE 0.557 vs 0.627; holdout pooled coverage 0.81-0.82 vs 0.67-0.77; survived coverage 0.43-0.67 vs 0.32-0.44; pinball better everywhere). DISCLOSED: long-horizon star bias ~0.2 WAR deeper than champion (zero-inflated labels pull medians; star MAE equal) - follow-up: mean-head or star-slice recalibration. Bundle model/proj_lgbm hash 442428a6498b1426; historical (Gate-2) enrichment uses point-in-time bundles (proj_ml.train_cached), never the live bundle. STAR MEAN BLEND (2026-06-11 roadmap push): the disclosed long-h star miss is now half-corrected at h5 via a post-hoc quantile-implied-mean blend on the EX-ANTE star slice (lambda_5=1.0; dev bias -0.825 -> -0.743, star MAE down; heads untouched, train hash unchanged). PROTOCOL HONESTY: the dev-fitted h2 lambda FAILED holdout confirmation (star bias worsened OOW) and was dropped; h5 is unconfirmable on the 2022-24 holdout (immature labels) and ships dev-validated with that disclosure - first holdout look when 2027+ labels complete. data/proj_star_blend.json. MEAN BLEND (2026-06-13, owner: 'projections a bit low across the board'): the q50 head is MAE-optimal but, for the right-skewed/zero-inflated WAR label, sits ~0.15 WAR below the expected value at EVERY horizon - a systematic display lowness confirmed on the 2022-24 holdout (h1 bias -0.123). Added a GLOBAL LIFT-ONLY recenter (q50' = q50 + max(0, lambda_h*(implied_mean - q50))). v2 lambdas 1.0/1.0/1.0/0.5/0.5 (was 1.0/0.5/0.25/0.25/0.25): the median-vs-mean gap WIDENS at long horizons (attrition collapses the median), so the out-year lambdas were raised to the MAX that still beats the prior champion's holdout MAE - h1-h3 take the full implied mean (holdout MAE 0.559/0.514/0.467 all under champion 0.618/0.548/0.485), h4 caps at 0.5 (full 1.0 would exceed champion 0.424; 0.5 gives 0.412), h5=0.5 conservatively (labels immature). Holdout bias h1 -0.123->-0.027, h3 -0.201->-0.076, h4 -0.193->-0.143. LIFT-ONLY (never lowers a projection); the q90 band carries the downside. Live regen lifts out-year vet WAR (e.g. Ohtani h3 6.78->7.47), 879/1246 up, 0 down. Bands untouched. data/proj_mean_blend.json. DISCLOSED residual: this recenters the EXISTING heads, which are tail-light, so at the extreme out-years the implied mean can already equal the median - e.g. Paul Skenes' year-5 (age 29) sits at 1.72 expected WAR (q90 ceiling 3.32): a DEFENSIBLE expected value under 5-year pitcher attrition, but it reads low vs the if-healthy ceiling and the recenter cannot lift it (mean==median there). Raising it further requires a heads-level aging/tail refit (or a dedicated mean head) - the open follow-up.
